notes: A reproducible transport scenario, not an estimate validated for the requested US survey domain. Canadian premenopausal survey ferritin anchors its marginal; a chosen left-tailed Hb mixture is broadly informed by New Zealand premenopausal Hb measurements. Original Chinese cell counts anchor a transported crude odds ratio; the adjusted OR is not substituted. Clayton lower-tail dependence is an explicit unverified assumption, especially consequential for Spearman. All rows are iid equal-weight virtual draws; no original people or target summaries used. No CRP filtering/correction, seed selection, or realized-moment adjustment.

ambiguities_and_omissions: Original mislabeled/very wide geometric-mean CIs not converted into individual SDs.
No target cohort data, outcomes, stored estimates or forbidden materials requested or used. One additional article retrieval was screened out; it supplies no model parameters.

The model omits explicit age, race, menses, BMI, inflammation and supplement covariates because only two measurements are requested and their joint target distribution is unidentified; it assumes their integrated effects can be transported phenomenologically.
No evidence claim is made that a single copula or the Hb mixture is uniquely correct. Repeating virtual people does not increase empirical information.

parameter_provenance.rationale: task-required size and complete-measurement domain; IDs are arbitrary, not source people

parameter_provenance.transfer: Adopt Canadian premenopausal descriptive marginal as a working proxy for the requested US nonpregnant20-44 weighted complete-measurement population. Geographic, temporal, pregnancy, ancestry, obesity, inflammation and laboratory differences remain unresolved. This is not a measured target value.

parameter_provenance.rationale: sigma roughly0.817 from two reported marginal anchors, conditional on ASSUMED lognormality; all positive-order ferritin moments finite. Implies P(F>150) about3.4%, close but not equal to reported2.7%; high tail not separately fitted.

parameter_provenance.parameter: Hb mixture weights0.85/0.15; means13.6/11.9 g/dL; SDs0.9/1.3 g/dL; component truncation[0,30] g/dL
parameter_provenance.rationale: Broadly healthy majority plus a lower-Hb tail of heterogeneous causes; components are not diagnosed groups and are not iron-deficiency indicators. Resulting arithmetic mean about13.345 and SD1.145 g/dL, between overall and European NZ source summaries. Lower-tail component allows clinically meaningful low Hb without symmetric extreme high Hb. Exact target mixture unidentified; truncation merely enforces finite physiologic output, with negligible affected normal mass. No original geometric intervals interpreted as SD.

parameter_provenance.transfer: Assume the source unadjusted threshold association, not its adjusted effect, transports unchanged despite differences in confounding, menstrual loss/IUD selection, baseline iron depletion, anemia causes, population structure and assays. This is an auditable scenario, not a causal claim or target estimate.

parameter_provenance.parameter: Clayton copula C(u,v)=(u^(-theta)+v^(-theta)-1)^(-1/theta); theta solves OR constraint at u=P(Hb<12),v=0.16
parameter_provenance.rationale: Choose lower-tail association and no asymptotic upper-tail dependence: depletion can impair erythropoiesis, whereas Hb need not rise indefinitely with ferritin. Theta is DERIVED under this chosen family from fixed population CDFs, never sample moments. The family and implied Spearman are not empirically identified. Other causes of anemia and acute-phase ferritin are integrated into residual marginal variation, not modeled as causal covariates.
parameter_provenance.source: zhu_cells supplies threshold OR only; zhu_continuous_limitations supports stronger iron relationship at low Hb

parameter_provenance.parameter: iid uniform-copula draws; no rounding, CRP filter, or ferritin correction; observed=None
parameter_provenance.rationale: Outputs represent unconditional raw measurements inside the specified complete-measurement domain. Reported marginal variability already includes measurement error; no separate error term added. Equal-weight rows assume donor evidence transports to the phlebotomy-weighted target domain without further weighting or missingness selection effects. Laboratory precision and within-group inflammatory dependence unknown.

requested_analyses.support: Original Table IV count aggregation gives the appropriate crude source OR. The population copula is calibrated to that transported threshold association.
requested_analyses.unresolved_dependencies: Target marginal transport, confounding/selection differences, raw ferritin acute-phase behavior and assay comparability. Finite5000-row estimates fluctuate; no realized2x2 counts are fixed. Any zero cell must remain not estimable without continuity correction.

requested_analyses.support: Implied jointly by Canadian ferritin marginal, chosen Hb mixture and transported crude OR; a=C(pHb,0.16). Original source joint173/1671 is recorded but deliberately not transplanted because the target marginal scenario differs.
requested_analyses.unresolved_dependencies: No target Hb or ferritin prevalence known; both transport and Hb mixture uncertainty materially affect joint prevalence. All rows used in the same2x2 table.

requested_analyses.support: Computed from continuous generated marginals linked by the selected Clayton copula; ordinary average-rank statistic on all rows.
requested_analyses.unresolved_dependencies: No reported Hb-ferritin Spearman identified. Threshold OR alone does not determine ranks. Copula lower-tail shape is the main unvalidated dependency; source folate-B12 r0.16 is expressly excluded. This result is exploratory model implication, not new empirical evidence.
